description: This file is a shell script used for testing and validation of Git command outputs, documentation consistency, and help message formatting. It includes functions for processing documentation files, checking output formats, and running assertions on command help outputs and documentation synchronization.

methods.name: help_to_synopsis
methods.description: Generates a synopsis file for a given git builtin command by extracting usage information from the command's help output.

methods.name: builtin_to_adoc
methods.description: Returns the path to the documentation file for a given git builtin command.

methods.name: adoc_to_synopsis
methods.description: Converts a documentation file into a synopsis format for comparison.

methods.name: check_dashed_labels
methods.description: Checks if the documentation contains dashed labels, ensuring formatting consistency.

methods.name: align_after_nl
methods.description: Normalizes spacing in help output for comparison.
